name: delivery-docket
title: Loan set delivery docket
for_each: select c.id, c.code from cases c where c.status in ('booked', 'confirmed') and c.surgery_on >= current_date and exists (select 1 from case_sets cs where cs.case_id = c.id) order by c.surgery_on

sections.title: Case
sections.sql: select c.code as case, c.surgery_on, h.name as hospital, sg.name as surgeon, c.procedure, c.patient_ref, r.name as rep, h.theatre_contact from cases c join hospitals h on h.id = c.hospital_id left join surgeons sg on sg.id = c.surgeon_id left join reps r on r.id = c.rep_id where c.id = $1

sections.title: Sets and delivery deadline
sections.note: Due at the hospital by the time shown, inside its loan set lead time.
sections.sql: select k.set_code, k.deliver_by, k.items_short, k.items_expiring, k.clashes_with from case_set_checks k join cases c on c.code = k.case_code where c.id = $1 order by k.set_code

sections.title: Contents
sections.sql: select s.code as set_code, p.sku, p.description, lo.lot_no, lo.expires_on, si.qty from case_sets cs join sets s on s.id = cs.set_id join set_items si on si.set_id = s.id join products p on p.id = si.product_id left join lots lo on lo.id = si.lot_id where cs.case_id = $1 and si.qty > 0 order by s.code, p.sku

name: charge-sheet
title: Implant charge sheet
for_each: select c.id, c.code from cases c where c.status = 'done' and exists (select 1 from usage u where u.case_id = c.id) order by c.surgery_on desc

sections.title: Case
sections.sql: select c.code as case, c.surgery_on, h.name as hospital, sg.name as surgeon, c.procedure, c.patient_ref, c.po_number, c.invoice_no from cases c join hospitals h on h.id = c.hospital_id left join surgeons sg on sg.id = c.surgeon_id where c.id = $1

sections.title: Items used
sections.note: Lot and serial numbers are the distribution record for each implant.
sections.sql: select p.sku, p.description, p.billing_code, lo.lot_no, u.serial_no, u.qty, u.price_cents, (u.qty * u.price_cents) as line_cents, u.implant_card_given from usage u join products p on p.id = u.product_id left join lots lo on lo.id = u.lot_id where u.case_id = $1 order by p.sku

sections.title: Total
sections.sql: select value_cents as total_cents, lines from case_value where id = $1

name: recall-customer-list
title: Market action customer list
for_each: select id, code from market_actions where status = 'open' order by code

sections.title: Market action
sections.sql: select ma.code, ma.kind, ma.country, ma.notified_on, p.sku, p.description, coalesce(lo.lot_no, 'all lots') as lot, ma.reason from market_actions ma join products p on p.id = ma.product_id left join lots lo on lo.id = ma.lot_id where ma.id = $1

sections.title: Every affected unit
sections.note: Stock and loan sets to pull, and patients' cases for the hospital to follow up.
sections.sql: select t.held_in, t.place, t.hospital, t.qty, t.case_code, t.surgery_on, t.patient_ref from recall_trace t join market_actions ma on ma.code = t.action where ma.id = $1 order by t.held_in, t.place

name: consignment-statement
title: Consignment stock statement
for_each: select id, name from locations where kind = 'consignment' order by code

sections.title: Location
sections.sql: select l.code, l.name, h.name as hospital, l.country from locations l left join hospitals h on h.id = l.hospital_id where l.id = $1

sections.title: Stock held on consignment
sections.sql: select p.sku, p.description, lo.lot_no, lo.expires_on, st.qty, (st.qty * p.price_cents) as value_cents, st.last_moved_on from stock st join products p on p.id = st.product_id left join lots lo on lo.id = st.lot_id where st.location_id = $1 and st.qty > 0 order by p.sku, lo.expires_on

sections.title: Against par
sections.sql: select k.sku, k.par, k.on_hand, k.to_replenish from consignment_check k join locations l on l.code = k.location where l.id = $1 order by k.sku
